description: Upload a file to the controller (creates or overwrites; the write is not atomic). content = text (UTF-8) or base64 = binary. make_dirs=true creates missing parent folders. System files (network, passwords, licence, cloud keys, web UI folders htm/ js/, slot folders) need MYIO_WRITE=admin. For flows.jsn / prog/N.txt prefer myio_flow_save / myio_script_save (validated + reloaded). Editor/admin level.

vol.description: q = internal flash (GIGA/Opta default), s = SD card (the only volume on a Due)

name: myio_file_write
title: Write a file
